senses.gloss: f.(b. h. בְּשׂרָה; בָּשַׂר)joy, glad tiding; in gen. tidings.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 16b:4">Keth. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>כוס של ב׳</he> cup of joy (wine carried in the bridal procession of a virgin), v. explan.

<cite ref="Ketubot 16b:4">ib.</cite>—Mekh. Bo. s. 12 <he>ב׳ רעה</he> evil prediction. Tanḥ. Ki. Thetse 4; Pesik. Zakh. p. 24ᵃ <he>בְּשׂוֹרַת אמו</he> the news of his mother’s death; a. e.—Pl. <he>בְּשׂוֹרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:1:7">Y. Keth. II, 26ᵇ</cite> top <he>חבית של ב׳</he> the keg of wine carried in the bridal procession, v. supra.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:4">Num. R. s. 14</cite> (play on <he>בשר</he> <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 12:12">Koh. XII, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Ezekiel 36:26">Ezek. XXXVI, 26</cite>) the Lord sends thee <he>ב׳ טובות</he> good tidings.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:2">Ber. IX, 2</cite> <he>ב׳ טובות</he> … <he>שמועות רעות</he> Mish. ed. (Talm. ed. 54ᵃ <he>ב׳ רעות</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) good tidings … bad news.
<cite ref="Shabbat 63a:21">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>אין … ב׳ רעות</he> no bad tidings will reach him.
